vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: garden
Version: 1.1.5

The OpenClaw Garden skill is benign. All files consistently describe a local-only garden management system. The `SKILL.md` explicitly states 'No external APIs or network calls' and 'No telemetry, analytics, or data collection', reinforcing that data stays within `~/garden/`. The only interaction outside this directory is a user-consented, one-line addition to the agent's main `MEMORY.md` for skill integration, as detailed in `setup.md`. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts designed to subvert the agent for harmful purposes.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only gardening assistant that reads and writes local files under ~/garden/ and its requested scope and actions align with its description.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (garden tracking, planning, diagnostics) match the instructions: create and manage files under ~/garden/, load plant/zone files on demand, and compute planting windows from user-provided climate info. There are no unrelated credentials, binaries, or services requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md and supporting docs confine actions to the garden workspace (~/garden/). Diagnostic and planning flows reference only plant/zone logs and user-supplied climate data. The only cross-workspace write is an optional single-line addition to the user's main memory file — and the docs state this will only be done after explicit user consent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only with no install spec and no code files; nothing is downloaded or written by an installer. That is the lowest-risk install surface.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are required. The requested filesystem access (~/garden/) is proportional to a local garden-tracking tool. The skill also explicitly claims no external APIs or telemetry.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal autonomous invocation are used (expected). The only persistent cross-scope change described is optionally adding a line to the user's main memory file with explicit consent; the user should verify where 'main memory' is stored and confirm before allowing that write.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it keeps data local under ~/garden/, requires no credentials, and has no install step. Before installing, confirm where your agent stores its ‘main’ MEMORY.md so you can control the optional one-line integration (deny if unsure). Review the ~/garden/ files the skill creates and set file permissions you’re comfortable with. If you plan to share photos with the agent, remember that photos themselves may be uploaded by the platform or agent — only provide images if you trust how they will be handled. Finally, while the skill's instructions state it makes no network requests, verify behavior after enabling it (e.g., watch first runs) so you can revoke access if it behaves differently than documented.
